closure.title: P0/P1 remediation closure — Epic 12.3b
closure.remediationSummary: All P0/P1 findings (R12-001, R12-002, R12-003) remediated and verified in PR #397 and PR #398. P2/P3 findings deferred with assigned owners and rationales.

closedFindings.closureNotes: Remediated via OutboundAddressSecurity: HTTP/HTTPS scheme enforcement, pre-connect DNS resolution, prohibited-address filtering (private RFC 1918, loopback, link-local, IPv6), redirect revalidation, user-info rejection, and deterministic connection/stream lifecycle management.
Remediated via JdbcSafeOperation sanitized database exception mapping across all JDBC store implementations.
Remediated via MaintainabilityBaselinePlugin ConsumerSmokeCompileTask explicit source file inputs.

deferredFindings.rationale: Retained for 0.4.x standalone backwards compatibility; 0.6.0 documentation directs users to governedPolicyFor.
DLP filters sanitize tool results before provider ingestion; PolicyEngine reinjection rules are scheduled for 0.7.0.
Sensitive headers and payloads are masked at the HTTP layer; exception-message redaction is scheduled for 0.7.0.
Official providers have dedicated exact-response tests; stricter shared ProviderTck content assertions are scheduled for 0.7.0.
Roundtrip decryption is asserted in the current JDBC suite; raw ciphertext assertions are scheduled for 0.7.0.
Shell authorization fails closed at the executable boundary; argument-aware policies are an expressiveness enhancement for 0.7.0.
The manifest test verifies deterministic canonical serialization; AST comparison is a resilience improvement for 0.7.0.
The shutdown test exercises graceful worker drain correctly; its historical class-name cleanup is scheduled for 0.7.0.
The provider change guide remains navigable and accurate; line-number refresh is scheduled for 0.7.0.
The store change guide remains accurate; line-number refresh is scheduled for 0.7.0.
The workflow-step change guide remains accurate; line-number refresh is scheduled for 0.7.0.
The structured-output change guide remains accurate; package-snippet refresh is scheduled for 0.7.0.
